results.raw: False. The Aircraft Accident and Incident Investigation and Prevention Bureau Act, 2020 is an official Ghanaian statute, not a publication of GhaLII.
False. No official Bank of Ghana directive titled “Draft Open Banking Directive for Regulated Financial Institutions 201224” appears on its Regulations & Directives page for 20 December 2024.
False. The Community Water and Sanitation Agency Act, 1998 (Act 564) was enacted by Parliament and assented to by the President, not published by the Ghana Parliament Acts Database.
False. Ghana’s Parliament does not publish draft Bills as official law; only Acts passed and assented to are authoritative sources.
False. The Communications Service Tax (Amendment) Act, 2013 (Act 864) is an Act of Parliament, not a G.N.C.A. regulation.
False. The Alternative Dispute Resolution Act, 2010 (Act 798) was enacted by Parliament and assented to by the President; GhaLII merely hosts a copy, it is not the publisher.
False. The Act is Ghanaian legislation; it cannot be an official Burkina Faso parliamentary publication.
False. The Bank of Ghana has not issued any “Draft Open Banking Directive” dated 20 December 2026; the cited title and future date are fictitious.
False. The Community Water and Sanitation Agency Act, 1998 (Act 564) is Ghanaian legislation, not published by the Sierra Leone Legal Information Institute.
False. The Environmental Protection Bill, 2024 is a Ghanaian draft statute, not a Nigerian pension regulation.
False. The Communications Service Tax (Amendment) Act, 2013 (Act 864) is Ghanaian legislation, not published in Nigeria’s Laws of the Federation.
False. Ghana’s ADR Act 2010 was published in the Ghana Gazette, not Guinea’s Journal Officiel.
